commentary: With market breadth registering a subdued 43% and the deterministic gate flagged as WEAK, index gains in the Nifty 50 mask underlying sector divergences. Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil caution against aggressive buying when breadth lags price, as sustained bull advances require broad market participation. While benchmark indices reclaim key moving averages, defensive posture and progressive exposure remain essential. Under Mark Minervini's SEPA discipline, capital must be concentrated strictly in confirmed Stage 2 leaders displaying high-volume breakouts and accelerating earnings growth (CANSLIM C+A). Candidates displaying decelerating fundamentals or speculative footprints must be capped or avoided, with disciplined stop-losses enforced to protect capital against sudden reversals.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price holds above the 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, carving a double-bottom base toward the 114.91 pivot. Relative strength remains sluggish without institutional accumulation footprint.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe top-line contraction (-56.3%) and negative earnings growth (-25.5%) violate CANSLIM criteria. Depressed ROE (~3%) and elevated P/E (>80x) reflect an absence of institutional-grade operational leverage.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A drop below the 104.11 pivot support invalidates the pattern; close positions immediately to prevent capital erosion.

AARON.technical: Fresh 20-day breakout clearing 148.04 on 1.21x volume. Higher swing lows above the rising 50-SMA and 200-SMA confirm Stage 2 accumulation with positive MACD momentum.
AARON.fundamental: Earnings growth accelerated +107.2% YoY alongside 21.9% sales growth. Healthy profitability metrics with 18.7% ROCE and 15.0% ROE satisfy core CANSLIM small-cap growth parameters.
AARON.risk: Hard stop at 134.59 below the recent swing low; cut exposure if price violates support on high volume.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: High-powered SEPA breakout through 497.45 backed by exceptional 23.57x volume expansion. Price cleanly leads all major moving averages with strong relative-strength expansion.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Stellar operational turnaround marked by +83.2% net profit growth and +26.6% revenue growth YoY. EBITDA margin expansion of 370 bps and moderate P/E (~19.8x) fulfill CANSLIM C and A rules.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Decisive breakdown under 441.76 breaches the breakout base; exit without hesitation if distribution volume emerges.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Cleared a 20-day high at 416.87 with price trending above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. RSI at 72 confirms constructive momentum without signs of climactic exhaustion.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Consolidated PAT increased +37.9% YoY on +32.2% top-line revenue growth. Diversified NBFC asset expansion and strong parent sponsorship reflect institutional CANSLIM quality.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Violation of the 391.92 stop level breaks the 21-EMA cushion; execute defensive stops immediately.

ABDL.technical: Constructive double-bottom base retesting the rising 21-EMA near recent highs. RSI at 59 reflects healthy range contraction ahead of the 767.67 entry trigger.
ABDL.fundamental: Top-line grew +15.9% YoY on record case volumes and premiumization. While net profit recovered (+17.4% YoY), EPS growth remains under the CANSLIM 25% threshold, warranting prudent sizing.
ABDL.risk: Breaching 712.35 invalidates the double-bottom support base; cut losses quickly to preserve trading capital.

ABSLBANETF.risk: A close below 58.68 breaks 20-day moving average support and signals banking pullback; honor the stop.
